title: Herod Kills James, Peter's Miraculous Escape from Prison

questions.question: King Herod killed James the brother of John with what?
options: The sword
By stoning
By beheading
By hanging
questions.explanation: Acts 12:2 (ESV): "He killed James the brother of John with the sword."

questions.question: Herod saw that killing James pleased the Jews, so he also arrested Peter. During what feast did this occur?
options: The days of Unleavened Bread
The feast of Weeks (Pentecost)
The feast of Tabernacles
The Passover proper
questions.explanation: Acts 12:3 (ESV): "And when he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to arrest Peter also. This was during the days of Unleavened Bread."

questions.question: How was Peter guarded in prison?
options: Bound with two chains, sleeping between two soldiers, with sentries before the door
In a deep cell with a large stone rolled against the entrance
Chained to the prison wall with four soldiers at the gate
Under constant watch by twelve guards in rotating shifts
questions.correctAnswer: Bound with two chains, sleeping between two soldiers, with sentries before the door
questions.explanation: Acts 12:6 (ESV): "...Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and sentries before the door were guarding the prison."

questions.question: What was the church doing while Peter was in prison?
options: Earnest prayer to God was made by the church for him
Fasting and weeping for three days
Gathering money to bribe the guards and free him
Preparing a memorial service expecting his death
questions.correctAnswer: Earnest prayer to God was made by the church for him
questions.explanation: Acts 12:5 (ESV): "So Peter was kept in prison, but earnest prayer for him was made to God by the church."

questions.question: When the angel appeared in prison and a light shone in the cell, what did the angel do to wake Peter?
options: Struck him on the side and said "Get up quickly"
Called his name twice at the cell door
Shook him gently by the shoulder
Caused a great light to blind him momentarily
questions.correctAnswer: Struck him on the side and said "Get up quickly"
questions.explanation: Acts 12:7 (ESV): "And behold, an angel of the Lord stood next to him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him, saying, 'Get up quickly.'"

questions.question: As Peter and the angel walked through the prison, past the first and second guards, what opened by itself?
options: The iron gate leading into the city
The outer prison door
The gate of the inner court
All the prison cell doors at once
questions.correctAnswer: The iron gate leading into the city
questions.explanation: Acts 12:10 (ESV): "When they had passed the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate leading into the city. It opened for them of its own accord..."

questions.question: Peter came to the house of Mary, the mother of John Mark. How many people were there?
options: Many were gathered together and were praying
Only a few trusted leaders remained up that night
The twelve apostles had gathered to fast and pray
The seven deacons led a vigil for Peter
questions.correctAnswer: Many were gathered together and were praying
questions.explanation: Acts 12:12 (ESV): "he went to the house of Mary, the mother of John whose other name was Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying."

questions.question: When Peter knocked at the door, a servant girl named Rhoda recognized his voice. What did she do instead of opening the door?
options: In her joy she ran in and told the others that Peter was standing at the gate, but left Peter outside
She called quietly for an elder to verify it was truly Peter
She opened the door a crack, saw him, and bolted it again in fear
She fainted from astonishment and had to be revived first
questions.correctAnswer: In her joy she ran in and told the others that Peter was standing at the gate, but left Peter outside
questions.explanation: Acts 12:14 (ESV): "Recognizing Peter's voice, in her joy she did not open the gate but ran in and reported that Peter was standing at the gate."

questions.question: When Rhoda insisted it was Peter and not just his spirit, what did those inside initially say?
options: "You are out of your mind"
"It cannot be, he is in chains"
"You must have seen his angel"
Both "You are out of your mind" and "It must be his angel"
questions.correctAnswer: Both "You are out of your mind" and "It must be his angel"
questions.explanation: Acts 12:15 (ESV): "They said to her, 'You are out of your mind.' But she kept insisting that it was so, and they kept saying, 'It is his angel!'"

questions.question: Peter instructed those gathered to tell James and the brothers what had happened. Which James is this referring to?
options: The brother of Jesus who led the Jerusalem church
The son of Zebedee (who had already been killed)
James the son of Alphaeus, one of the twelve
James the Elder who served as an apostle in Antioch
questions.correctAnswer: The brother of Jesus who led the Jerusalem church
questions.explanation: Acts 12:17 (ESV): "...and he described to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, 'Tell these things to James and to the brothers.'" This James (Jesus' brother) led the Jerusalem church after the apostle James was killed.

questions.question: After a search for Peter, Herod examined the soldiers. What did he order done to them?
options: He commanded that they should be put to death
He had them flogged and imprisoned temporarily
He dismissed them from service in disgrace
He ordered them to search all of Judea for Peter
questions.correctAnswer: He commanded that they should be put to death
questions.explanation: Acts 12:19 (ESV): "And after Herod searched for him and did not find him, he examined the sentries and ordered that they should be put to death."

questions.question: Herod made a speech and the people cried out "The voice of a god, and not of a man!" What happened immediately to Herod?
options: An angel of the Lord struck him down because he did not give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and breathed his last
He fell to the ground struck blind and never recovered
A great earthquake toppled the platform on which he stood
He was struck with a terrible disease for blaspheming God
questions.correctAnswer: An angel of the Lord struck him down because he did not give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and breathed his last
questions.explanation: Acts 12:23 (ESV): "Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him down, because he did not give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and breathed his last."

questions.question: The people of Tyre and Sidon sought peace with Herod because their country depended on what from Herod's region?
options: The king's country for food
Trade routes through Judea
Roman military protection
Water from the Galilean springs
questions.explanation: Acts 12:20 (ESV): "...because their country depended on the king's country for food."

questions.question: What did Peter first think when the angel appeared in his cell?
options: He was seeing a vision
He was dreaming
He was still awake
An earthquake was coming
questions.explanation: Acts 12:9 (ESV): "And he went out and followed him. He did not know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision."

questions.question: After Herod's death, the word of God continued to do what?
options: Increase and multiply
Spread westward to Rome
Reach all corners of the Roman Empire
Bring great fear throughout Judea
questions.explanation: Acts 12:24 (ESV): "But the word of God increased and multiplied."

key_verse_text: But the word of God increased and multiplied.
